title: Request
description: One operation. `command` selects the operation; the other fields depend on it.

oneOf.description: Report the software version.
Return one JSON Schema, or write schemas to files.
Load a project, ZMX, calculation record or scan directory and return it.

catalogs.description: Extra AGF catalog folders for ZMX import.

path.description: File, or a scan directory containing `scan.json`.

viewer_paths.description: For calculation records: retrace up to 64 sample rays to draw light paths.

oneOf.description: Load a model, report its compatibility and optionally save it as project JSON.

catalogs.description: Extra AGF catalog folders for ZMX import.

export_zmx.description: Also export the model as ZMX (standalone models only).

include_project.description: Return the imported project in the result.

output.description: Save the imported project JSON here.

oneOf.description: Trace a model and return (and optionally save) the calculation record.

catalogs.description: Extra AGF catalog folders for ZMX import.

export_zmx.description: Also export the effective model as ZMX before tracing.

include_record.description: Return the full calculation record in the result.

max_total_rays.description: Reject generated runs with more launch rays than this.

output.description: Save the calculation record (the `schema name=run` format) here.

paths.description: Save every path segment of the first N launch rays in input order.

preview_paths.description: Replace `report.paths` with up to N sample rays spread over all sources (GUI preview).

rays.description: Explicit launch rays; omitted uses the model sources.

terminals.description: Save terminal rays in the report.

threads.description: Worker threads; omitted uses the runtime default.

warmup.description: Run one untimed trace before the timed repetitions.

oneOf.description: Rerun a calculation record with its recorded optical conditions.

threads.description: Worker threads; omitted uses the recorded count.

oneOf.description: Run a parameter scan into a new directory.

catalogs.description: Extra AGF catalog folders for ZMX import.

include_manifest.description: Return the scan manifest in the result.

output.description: New directory for `scan.json` and the case records.

oneOf.description: Continue the unfinished cases of a scan directory.
Trace the model with varied ray counts, seeds, pixels and CAD deflections.

model.description:
Model file (`model.path`); CAD deflection comparisons need the original
STEP-referencing ZMX, because each case re-reads it.

output.description: Directory for `convergence.json` and the case records.

oneOf.description: Save a project as JSON.
Save a calculation record as JSON.
Export a standalone model as ZMX.

catalogs.description: Extra AGF catalog folders for ZMX import.

oneOf.description: Write CSV/PNG/metadata files for one screen of a calculation record.

cursor_mm.description: Local-mm position of the extra X/Y profiles.

back.description: Incidence from the plus side; omission uses the front model on both sides.

front.description: Incidence from the minus side of the surface normal.

zemax_definition.description: Original named coating block, including S/P and phase data for lossless exchange.

coefficients.description: Angle-major, then wavelength; each element is [R, T] in power units.

low_index_angle.description: Zemax TABLE angles refer to the lower-index medium on either traversal.

anchor_mm.description: Local point placed at pose.translation_mm; lens first vertex / source-array centre.

component.description: Zero-based index in the assembly; None denotes a standalone project.

ConvergencePlan.description: `plan` of the `convergence` command. Every combination is traced.

allow_uncoated.description: Trace coated surfaces as uncoated Fresnel interfaces.

cad_deflections_mm.description: CAD tessellation deflections in mm; needs the original STEP-referencing ZMX.

pixels.description: Detector pixel counts `[x, y]`; empty keeps the model setting.

ray_counts.description: Rays per source; an empty list keeps the model setting.

save_runs.description: Save a replayable calculation record for each case.

seeds.description: Seed of the first source (later sources use +1, +2, ...); empty keeps the model setting.

wavelength_um.description: Replace the source spectra with one wavelength in micrometres.

weights.description: Row-major: row y, column x. Values are integrated pixel power, not density.

oneOf.description: The minus/plus medium is on the -/+ side of the local sag normal.

origin_mm.description: Position from which the failed interface search started.

blocking.description: An unsupported physical definition prevents tracing.

oneOf.description: n² = 1 + sum(B_i * lambda² / (lambda² - C_i)). C_i has units um².
n² = A0 + A1*l² + A2/l² + A3/l⁴ + A4/l⁶ + A5/l⁸ (AGF formula 1).
Sorted [wavelength_um, n] pairs. Linear interpolation, no extrapolation.

Mode.description:
`sequential` follows the surface order and terminates at TIR;
`non_sequential` follows the nearest hit and splits reflection and transmission.

ModelInput.description: An optical model given by file path or inline JSON. Exactly one key.

oneOf.description: `.zmx`, project JSON or scene JSON file.
Inline project JSON (the `schema name=project` format).
Inline scene JSON (the `schema name=scene` format, as in `examples/*.json`).

Overrides.description: Changes applied to the loaded model before tracing. Omitted fields keep the model.

ignore_coatings.description: Trace coated surfaces as uncoated Fresnel interfaces (changes the physics).

max_rays_per_source.description: Upper limit of rays per source (applied after `rays_per_source`).

wavelength_um.description: Replace every source spectrum with one wavelength in micrometres.

Parameter.description: Scanned value. Indices are zero-based; axis 0/1/2 is X/Y/Z.

oneOf.description: Assembly component position in mm.
Assembly component rotation in degrees.
Rod width X / width Y / length (axis 0/1/2) in mm.
Standalone-model surface position in mm.
Standalone-model surface rotation in degrees.
Wavelength of every source in micrometres.

ParameterLink.description: target = source * scale + offset; scale is dimensionless, offset uses target units.

rotation_deg.description: Active rotations: Rx, then Ry, then Rz, in the world frame.

Project.description:
Editable project saved by the GUI and `--inspect`: the scene, its source documents
(ZMX definitions, assembly components) and import issues.

PupilIllumination.description:
Uniform area samples on a pupil. Finite objects emit from a point; infinite
objects launch a parallel bundle whose intersections fill the pupil.

RaysInput.description: Explicit launch rays instead of the model sources. Exactly one key.

oneOf.description: CSV with the header `id,x_mm,y_mm,z_mm,dx,dy,dz,weight,wavelength_um,medium`.
Inline rays; ids must be unique.

RecordInput.description: A calculation record given by file path or inline JSON. Exactly one key.

coatings.description: Optional power coatings on entrance, exit, or sides.

project.description: The editor state, including original documents, local components and overrides.

scene.description: Exact effective scene after CLI overrides or GUI preview limits.

ScanPlan.description: `plan` of the `scan` command. At most 256 cases.

rays_per_source.description: Rays per source for every case; null keeps the model setting.

secondary.description: Optional second axis; every combination with `values` is traced.

values.description: Values of `parameter` in its unit (mm, deg or um).

Scene.description:
Optical model: materials, surfaces, sources and trace limits.
Lengths are mm and wavelengths are micrometres. `examples/*.json` use this format.

materials.description: Material table; surfaces and rays refer to materials by index. Index 0 is usually air.

reference_plane.description: Describes where the launched weight is counted as 100 %.

surfaces.description: Surfaces in sequential order (non-sequential tracing uses the nearest hit).

oneOf.description: Request accepted by `raytrace-rs run`.
Response printed by the CLI.
Optical model, as in `examples/*.json`.
Project JSON saved by the GUI and `inspect`.
Calculation record saved by `trace` and `replay`.
`scan.json` in a scan directory.
`convergence.json` in a convergence directory.

ScreenRoi.description:
Rectangular ROI integral: partially covered pixels contribute by area overlap.
The interpolation assumes constant power density within each recorded pixel.

oneOf.description: Side of a closed lens barrel: z in [0,length], outward-pointing normal.
Coefficients are A4, A6, A8, ... in increasing order.
The vertex-centred sag cap; radius is signed. This is not a full sphere.
Coefficients are A4, A6, A8, ... in increasing order.

total_weight.description: Arbitrary power units; the sum at launch defines the reference plane.

samples.description: Ascending [wavelength_um, relative_power] pairs, sampled without interpolation.

branch_count.description: Counts terminal branches, not unique launch IDs.

path_launch_count.description: Store every segment belonging to the first N launch rays in input order, including branches.

surface_numbers.description: One source-document surface number per editable sequential surface.
